name: ListConsumers

parameters.help_en:
The display status filter. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled and not expired.
Disabled: Disabled, regardless of whether it has expired.
Expired: Enabled and expired.
If this parameter is not specified, all statuses are included, and the result is intersected with other filter conditions
parameters.help_zh: 展示状态筛选：Enabled 已启用且未过期、Disabled 已停用（不论是否过期）、Expired 已启用且过期。未传表示全部，与其它筛选条件取交集
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The expiration status filter. Valid values: Permanent, InEffect, AboutToExpire, and Expired. You can specify multiple values separated by commas to form a union. If this parameter is not specified, all statuses are included, and the result is intersected with the name and display status filters
parameters.help_zh: 有效期状态筛选：Permanent、InEffect、AboutToExpire、Expired。可用英文逗号连接多个值取并集；未传表示全部，与名称及展示状态取交集
parameters.name: expire_status

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the total count of expiration reminders. Default value: false. The statistical scope is limited only by the current account and gatewayType
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回全量到期提醒计数，缺省 false。统计范围只受当前账号与 gatewayType 限制
parameters.name: include_expiration_summary

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to perform a fuzzy search by API name
parameters.help_zh: 按接口名称模糊搜索接口
parameters.name: name_like

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从1开始，不填默认1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The gateway type filter. Currently, AI and API gateway types are supported
parameters.help_zh: 网关类型过滤，目前支持AI、API两种网关类型
parameters.name: gateway_type

expirationSummary.description_en: The count of expiration reminders for all consumers under the same account and gateway type. This count is not affected by name, status filters, or pagination. This field is returned only when includeExpirationSummary is set to true
expirationSummary.description_zh: 同账号、同网关类型全部消费者的到期提醒计数，不受名称、状态筛选或分页影响。仅 includeExpirationSummary=true 时返回

aboutToExpire.description_en: The number of unexpired consumers with a remaining validity period of seven days or less, including those that are manually disabled
aboutToExpire.description_zh: 未过期且剩余时间不超过七天的消费者数量，包括手动停用者
aboutToExpire.title_en: 未过期且剩余时间不超过七天的消费者数量，包括手动停用者。
aboutToExpire.title_zh: 未过期且剩余时间不超过七天的消费者数量，包括手动停用者。

expired.description_en: The number of expired consumers, including those that are manually disabled

deployStatus.description_en: The publish status of the API in the current environment

enable.description_en: Specifies whether the consumer is enabled

expireAt.description_en: The expiration time of the consumer, in UTC UNIX seconds. A null value indicates that the consumer is permanently valid
expireAt.description_zh: 消费者失效时间，UTC Unix 秒。空值表示永久有效
expireAt.title_en: 消费者失效时间，UTC Unix 秒。空值表示永久有效。

expireStatus.description_en: The expiration status. Valid values: Permanent, InEffect, AboutToExpire, and Expired. The status is accurate to the second. A remaining validity period of exactly seven days is classified as AboutToExpire, and an expired status is classified as Expired
expireStatus.description_zh: 有效期状态：Permanent、InEffect、AboutToExpire 或 Expired。精确到秒；恰好七天属于 AboutToExpire，到点属于 Expired
expireStatus.title_en: 有效期状态：Permanent、InEffect、AboutToExpire 或 Expired。精确到秒；恰好七天属于 AboutToExpire，到点属于 Expired。
expireStatus.title_zh: 有效期状态：Permanent、InEffect、AboutToExpire 或 Expired。精确到秒；恰好七天属于 AboutToExpire，到点属于 Expired。
